newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity rehires Grenier, shuffles a few managers. [CORRECTED 14:56 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Fidelity rehires Grenier, shuffles a few managers. [CORRECTED 14:56 GMT]

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Friday it has rehired Bart Grenier and it has shuffled the managers of seven small mutual funds.
Grenier (corrects name from Hayes), a former assistant head of the equity division who left Fidelity in April, was named vice president and head of the high-income division.
Grenier, who most recently worked with DDJ Capital Management LLC, succeeds Robert Lawrence, who recently was named associate director and senior vice president of the equity division.
In addition, Fidelity named Nick Thakore as portfolio manager of Fidelity Utilities Fund, Fidelity Select Utilities Growth Portfolio and Fidelity Advisor Utilities Growth Fund, effective August 18.

Thakore was also named sector leader for the utilities equity research group. He succeeds John Muresianu, who has been named associate portfolio manager of American Trust Portfolio, an offshore diversified equity fund managed by Fidelity International Limited, sister company of Fidelity Investments.
Thakore will continue to manage Fidelity Select Telecommunications Portfolio.
Douglas Chase was named portfolio manager of Fidelity Select Consumer Industries Portfolio and Fidelity Advisor Consumer Industries Fund, also effective August 18, 1997.

Chase, who will continue to manage Fidelity Select Automotive Portfolio, was also named sector leader of the consumer industries equity research group. He succeeds Paul Antico, who will continue to manage Fidelity Select Leisure Portfolio.
James Catudal was named portfolio manager of Fidelity Select Industrial Materials Portfolio, succeeding Chase, also effective August 18, 1997.
